title: Kissed Yellow Greek Semolina Custard Galaktoboureko
description: A traditional Greek dessert featuring semolina custard and a crispy phyllo crust, with a hint of yellow food coloring and a rich, resinous flavor from the lardons-render, served in a bento box for a unique twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the semolina flour, sugar, and 1/4 cup of the milk, whisking to avoid lumps.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in the eggs, one at a time, followed by the lardons-render and yellow food coloring.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of the dough into a bento box, brushing with some of the melted butter.
Spoon some of the semolina custard into the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the custard, brushing the edges with a little water to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and custard.
Brush the tops of the galaktoboureko with the remaining butter and bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
